headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong top‑line gains while others saw modest or slowing performance.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% YoY growth, the weakest among the majors. Most peers reported double‑digit revenue growth, supported by AI‑related contracts, but profit margins varied. Guidance was introduced or revised for HCLTech and Wipro, indicating a focus on future outlook.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several companies highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys AI revenue up 29% YoY, LTM AI revenue up 47%, Mphasis 66% of contracts AI‑led, and HCLTech AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin pressure and guidance changes
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance, while Coforge raised its EBIT margin target. HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% FY27 growth guide.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and upgraded FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16%.

laggards.why: Only 1.5% YoY revenue growth and a cut in FY27 revenue guidance.
